name: paperclip
description: Keeps a Claude Code session aware of the Paperclip issue it is working on: status in the context, transitions as notifications, and a pc CLI wrapper on PATH. Read-only in v0.

api_base.title: Paperclip API base URL
api_base.description: Where your Paperclip server is reachable.

company_id.title: Company ID
company_id.description: Company this session's agent belongs to.

agent_id.title: Agent ID or shortname
agent_id.description: The Paperclip agent this session acts as, e.g. claudecoder.

api_key.title: Agent API key
api_key.description: Long-lived agent key from `paperclipai agent local-cli`. Stored in secure storage, not settings.json.

data_dir.title: Paperclip data dir (optional)
data_dir.description: Set only when pointing at an isolated test-drive instance instead of ~/.paperclip.

poll_seconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often the watcher checks issue status.

review_ready_statuses.title: Review-ready statuses
review_ready_statuses.description: Comma-separated issue statuses that mean the task is ready for your review.

terminal_statuses.title: Terminal statuses
terminal_statuses.description: Comma-separated statuses after which the watcher stops polling. The server's enum is: backlog, todo, in_progress, in_review, done, blocked, cancelled.
